heroHeadline: Nevada Caps Tesla Robotaxi Fleet at 10 Vehicles, Far Below 5,000 Requested
heroSubtitle: The week of May 21–28, 2026 saw a surge of solid-state battery milestones: Ganfeng Lithium commenced small-batch production of a 500 Wh/kg lithium-metal solid-state cell — the first globally at this production stage — while the Chinese Academy of Sciences published a 451.5 Wh/kg solid-state battery achieving 20C rate (3-minute charge) and passing nail-penetration safety tests. Spain's Basquevolt launched the BQV400L cell at 402 Wh/kg with a Renault Ampere partnership — the first credible European-owned solid-state-adjacent battery at competitive energy density — and Taiwan's ProLogium announced a $3.8 billion Nasdaq SPAC listing to fund its Dunkirk, France solid-state gigafactory (mass production ramp Q2 2029). BYD filed a composite sulfide solid electrolyte patent targeting 2027 pilot production, and China was warned by its own analysts that a volumetric patent lead does not guarantee commercialization dominance. On the grid-storage front, Sungrow secured a landmark 7.5 GWh contract for Masdar's UAE gigawatt-scale 24/7 renewable energy project — the largest single-project battery storage contract globally — while Spearmint Energy closed $450 million in financing for a 300 MW/600 MWh standalone BESS in Texas. Lithium carbonate in China spiked to a two-year high of ~$27,600/tonne on May 13 before retreating to ~$24,400 by month-end.
footerNote: Data sourced from official company reports, IEA, BloombergNEF, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, SNE Research, pv magazine, and peer-reviewed publications. Lab results distinguished from commercial production figures throughout.
